_: Listening notes on the BASILISK 16 1.2.0 demo renders. 'drop' removes an automatic flag that listening showed to be a false alarm; 'note' is shown on the page beside the preset.

chord-thump.note: Silent on Windows 3.11: after << the position is at the start, so ] (Delete After Current Position) deletes the whole sound and the layer is empty.

critical-bass.note: critstop is an XP sound, so 3.11 plays DING. Slowed four times by <<, DING's short lead-in becomes about 0.4 s of silence, so short notes end before they sound.

hardware-sub.note: hwin and hwout are XP sounds, so 3.11 plays DING. Slowed four times by <<, its lead-in becomes about 0.4 s of silence, so short notes end before they sound.

bowl-swell.note: The singing_bowl_c layers are very quiet: about -48 LUFS before the demo's normalizing.

echo-count.note: Macro 1 steps the echo count (N), so Windows rebuilds the recorders. In this offline render the chords that land during each rebuild (at 3 s and 5 s) are dropped.

macro-echoes.note: Macro 1 steps the echo count (N), so Windows rebuilds the recorders. In this offline render the chords that land as each rebuild starts (at 2 s and 4 s) are dropped.

telephone-choir.note: The renderer reported 3 of its notes started late on the emulated card (unison: 9 voices per chord note); not audible here.
